svg.title: Thirumaran S L — AI/ML developer
svg.desc: Thirumaran S L fixes bugs in the ML frameworks he uses. A terminal window lists his seven merged upstream commits: quest, two in PyTorch, Brevitas, vLLM, TensorFlow and Aider.
